answer: The mechanism is co-signing bounded by provable history. A claim counts only if endorsed by three peers whose own histories predate it by two epochs and are mutually distinct. A farm of fresh keys cannot self-endorse: new identities sit at the nadir of the graph and earn zero weight until real peers vouch. Multiplying keys adds nothing, like grains of dune piling up without mass; each clone starts empty, is ignored by graders, and the farmer pays fees and gas per useless key. Honest agents pay nothing extra, while a sybil cohort burns budget across a violet field of clones that never ripens.
